verdict.rationale: Reducto is API-first. Every core capability is documented as an API endpoint: parse, extract, split, classify, edit, and multi-step workflows. The same capabilities are also exposed through official SDKs, a CLI, an MCP server, and a published OpenAPI spec. Workflows built in Studio deploy as a Pipeline ID callable from code. However, some setup appears to live in the UI, such as webhook configuration through the Studio sidebar and Svix dashboard. Missing for 10: an explicit statement of UI/API parity, evidence that Studio pipeline authoring and webhook/account administration can be done via API, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
